scope: Finite successful 64-iteration workload; no universal law/proof. Sealed before private implementation or execution. Logical undo/commands/events only; no allocation/RSS/lifecycle stamps claim.
order: Grouped: actual main seed, actual foreign seed, reserve Local-owner sequence, dispose Local-owner sequence. This is NOT chronological interleaving.

derivation.main-seed: F.seed_rows creates N actual reservations, each one inverse+command; sample returned actual F.Reserved.tx then original F.seeded/Cmd.tx_finish.
derivation.foreign-seed: One actual Cmd.tx_spawn before original foreign_reserved finish.
derivation.reserve: One spawn per successful loop creates one pending inverse and one deferred command.
derivation.dispose: Structural.tx_remove queues one command, no inverse; tx_despawn_with queues another, no inverse; zero events. Sample actual Tx on success/failure before original finish.
derivation.Select: Real per-handle Tx is created by Contract.scan_handles; read-only derived main_read selector cannot append undo/commands/events, unselect rolls it back. Not NoTx; unchanged source applicability, not invented observed-zero sample.
derivation.failure: Actual prefinish Tx sampled on every accepted/rejected transactional branch; no fabricated successful count on failure. Local carrier returns original Array and detached samples.
